public_rationale: The approximate page count has a basis in Alpöge's announcement, although it describes a generated exposition rather than a released conventional paper. This finding does not disprove Marcus's statement about what he personally had heard or adjudicate elegance and usefulness.
limitations: Mixed applies only to the checkable components under the stated interpretation.
